Tonnetz melody model v5 — training-data notice

The model was trained on an original programmatic phrase corpus and selected
monophonic vocal excerpts from OpenScore/Lieder, licensed CC0 1.0 Universal.
Source: https://github.com/OpenScore/Lieder
Pinned commit: 38c5db510224d9facdc4b08d741fc788cfb58ea8
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Credit: OpenScore Lieder contributors and the composers/editions identified in
the source repository. No source audio recordings or lyrics were used.
Piano harmony and key mode are inferred, not human-provided labels. The real
excerpts are labeled classical; they do not establish jazz, pop or blues realism.
The 15 held-out works are validation data used for checkpoint selection, not an
untouched final test set. Prediction and structural metrics do not demonstrate
listener preference or professional composition quality.

Reproduction and limitations: docs/tonnetz-melody-v5.md in the project source.
